reader.requirement: At --std 85 COMPUTE must follow the cross-referenced 1985 rules: scope (END-COMPUTE), ROUNDED (absolute value increased by one when the excess's leading digit is >= 5, relative to the rightmost stored integer position of a P receiver), ON SIZE ERROR (exponentiation violation, zero divisor, overflow after rounding with a BINARY receiver limited by its PICTURE; affected receivers unchanged with the phrase; without the phrase undefined values and control to the end of the statement, NOT ON SIZE ERROR ignored), operand conversion, overlap and multiple results.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 an unphrased size error (zero divisor included) is caught and the next statement runs; from 2002 it is a fatal EC-SIZE
Constructs.ConditionalPhrasesAnyOrder2002 (ConstructRegistry row conditional-phrases-any-order-2002): ON SIZE ERROR after NOT ON SIZE ERROR is refused below 2002 (COBOL0900)
OPTIONS inert below 2002: NATIVE arithmetic and the default ROUNDED mode (nearest-away-from-zero)

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectBehavior|DialectLevel in ArithmeticEmitter.cs and ConditionRenderer.cs; ConstructRegistry.g.cs for the phrase-order construct; OptionsBinder for the arithmetic and rounding defaults.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: an unphrased size error at 85 transfers control to the end of the statement (S5/S6 print CONTINUED); at 2023 the same program ends with EC-SIZE-ZERO-DIVIDE (fatal); the NOT-before-ON phrase order is refused at 85 only
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses (overlap, mixed descriptions, multiple receivers, multi-receiver size error) are 2023-numbered cases run at 85; not exercised by them: the 1985 unphrased size-error continuation, ROUNDED on a P receiver, the BINARY receiver's PICTURE limit, rounding before the size check, exponentiation violation

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.8.4 GR4  (║6.8.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: Every cross-referenced 1985 rule probed held at --std 85, including the 1985-only continuation after an unphrased size error (the same probe ends fatally at --std 2023, as 2002+ requires). The edition's own arm exists where 1985 differs (EmitArith's dialect behavior, the phrase-order construct).
reader.at-2023: comp2.cob at --std 2023: R1..S4 identical, then abnormal run-unit termination EC-SIZE-ZERO-DIVIDE at S5 (the 2002+ rule)

refuter.evidence: Exponentiation violations of §1985:VI.6.4.2 (1) the reader did not try beyond 0 ** 0: rcomp.cob X1 COMPUTE R1 = NB ** 0.5 with NB = -4 -> SIZE, R1 unchanged +11.00; X2 ZB ** -1 with ZB = 0 -> SIZE unchanged; X12 (NB + 4) ** 0 -> SIZE unchanged. X13 -0.005 ROUNDED into S99V99 -> -00.01 (absolute value increased). X14: COMPUTE R3 = 1000 with no phrase -> control continues (the 1985 arm). rcnot.cob: Y1 NOT ON SIZE ERROR ignored when a receiver overflows; Y2 ADD 900 TO A B C with only NOT ON SIZE ERROR -> C 0900 stored, NOT phrase ignored; Y3 COMPUTE B C = 7 / Q with Q = 0 and no phrase -> continues (Y3 CONT); Y4 printed the ON SIZE ERROR arm because B PIC 999 cannot hold 2000 (my probe's label, the size error is correct).
